result:
Perfect! I've set up the sync daemon to run automatically at boot. Here's what I did:

1. **Created `scripts/sync-daemon.ps1`** — A PowerShell script that runs continuously in the background, executing `sync.sh` every hour and logging results to `data/sync-daemon.log`

2. **Created `sync-daemon.bat` in Windows Startup folder** — A batch file that launches the daemon at system boot without requiring admin privileges
   - Location: `/home/author\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup\sync-daemon.bat`

The sync daemon will now:
- Start automatically when you boot or log in
- Run `scripts/sync.sh` every hour to pull the upstream feed
- Log all activity to `data/sync-daemon.log`
- Keep running in the background indefinitely

The setup is complete and will take effect on your next restart.
